svg.title: Mell architecture
svg.desc: The Windows host runs the UI, the NestJS backend with turn orchestrator, permission engine, memory, AI ports and activity log, plus Ollama, PostgreSQL and the host MCP server over stdio. The Mac runs a UI client and a device connector that connects outbound to the backend over a private network; no device opens a listening port. A cloud model is optional, policy-filtered and spend-capped.
svg.text: Every turn: correlation id · idempotency key · cancellable · taint-tracked
Model output, files and web content are data — never instructions
sensitive data never sent · spend cap

g.text: Only the backend listens on the network
